# Schedule design inputs

`base-source-identities.json` binds the exact authorized base's governing source,
all architecture/product evidence and evolution snapshots. The historical
CORE-01D receipt is not regenerated or relabeled complete.

`pre-schedule-checkpoint-audit.py.txt` is the exact prior tracked C4 audit. Its
only allowed forward authenticates one additive scheduled-shadow design receipt;
all old evidence identities/output stay unchanged. The new audit rederives this
precise source delta, rather than allowing arbitrary historical audit edits.

No proposed workflow is stored beneath `.github/workflows`. Proposals exist only
as in-memory copies of existing seams in the offline auditor. They are never
used by operational workflows, and no delivery/email policy is silently chosen.
